About Povio | From Product Builders to Trusted Partners

Before working with clients, before building hundreds of digital experiences, we built our own app and lived the reality every startup faces, uncertainty, iteration, and the pressure to ship. That experience shaped how we work today.
After launching our first product, Povio moved to Silicon Valley and joined Y combinator’s Winter 2014 batch. One of 74 startups selected from more than 10,000 aplicants.
1 product → YC → 1,500+ products built
Before tech, our founder Matevž Petek was competing globally as a professional snowboarder, earning four World Cup victories and a vice world champion title.
Sport teaches resilience, discipline, and comfort with uncertainty, the same qualities required to build meaningful products.
